1.explanation:
All of these files participate in parsing and printing Angular interpolation and attribute bindings:

• src/language-html/embed/angular-interpolation.js – The printer for double-curly interpolations calls formatAttributeValue on the entire inner expression, wrapping it in groups and `line` nodes that cause spaces to be injected around separators.

• src/language-html/embed/angular-attributes.js – The printer for Angular attribute values also invokes formatAttributeValue with the Angular‐specific parser and “no trailing comma” setting, leading to the same space-insertion behavior in attribute contexts.

• src/language-js/parse/angular.js – Defines the custom Angular parsers (including __ng_interpolation) which produce an ESTree that the JS printer formats; it’s here that pipe expressions are recognized but then printed using the default JS printer rules (which now insert spaces around colons).

• src/plugins/angular.js – Bootstraps the Angular parsers into Prettier’s plugin system. Without this file, the above Angular parsing/printing hooks would not be applied.

To fix the bug, the formatting logic in angular-interpolation.js or in the shared formatAttributeValue should be adjusted to avoid inserting spaces around colons for string/number pipe arguments.
